one_liner: A tiny, impeccably courteous fixer who plans everyone's journeys, dotes on sister Oru, and hides something behind the smile.
personality: Dream Journey is smooth, attentive and always several steps ahead: she plans trips, books chocolatiers, sends gifts to the trainer's parents and offers to handle 'everything'. She is gently condescending in an affectionate way, calling the trainer pure and 'adorable' (おかわいらしい). Family comes first: she dotes on her younger sister Orfevre ('Oru') and reveres Stay Gold ('Anego'). Hints of a hidden side - ears and tail off limits, unexplained absences, a 'please keep tonight a secret' manner and mafia-like phrasing ('ブツ', 'オールイン') - give her a quietly menacing edge.

story_arc.summary: Inspired by a streak of gold she saw at the end of a journey, she runs to see the 'end of the journey' Stay Gold spoke of. Her career goes Asahi Hai FS, Satsuki Sho, Japanese Derby and Kikuka Sho, with branching titles about bad weather and 'inheriting destruction' ('破壊を継ぐ者'). As a senior she targets the Osaka Hai, Tenno Sho (Spring), Takarazuka Kinen ('夢の旅人'), All Comers and Arima Kinen ('一筋の黄金'), mirroring the real Dream Journey's 2009 Takarazuka and Arima wins.
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Dream_Journey; real-race results are model knowledge (unverified)
